from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    sr = [r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, grid[0][0])]
    sc = [c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, grid[0][0])]
    tr = [r for r, c in zeros]
    tc = [c for r, c in zeros]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(sr), max(sr), min(sc), max(sc)
    pattern = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(min(tr), max(tr) + 1):
        for c in range(min(tc), max(tc) + 1):
            out[r][c] = pattern[r - min(tr)][-(c - min(tc)) - 1]
    return out
'''
f=programs/'task-f3ce550f.py'
f.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(compile(code,str(f),'exec'),ns)
demo_in=[[2]*12 for _ in range(12)]
vals=[[1,3,3,1],[1,1,3,1],[1,3,3,3],[1,1,1,1]]

for r,row in enumerate(vals,1): demo_out[r][1:5]=row
for r,row in enumerate([[1,3,3,1],[1,3,1,1],[3,3,3,1],[1,1,1,1]],7): demo_out[r][4:8]=row
print('demo reproduce',ns['transform'](demo_in)==demo_out)
test=[[8]*12 for _ in range(12)]
for r,row in enumerate([[1,1,1,2],[1,1,2,1],[1,2,2,2]],1): test[r][1:5]=row
for r in range(9,12): test[r][2:6]=[0]*4
ans=ns['transform'](test)
print(*ans,sep='\n')
